title: Can AI Relate: Testing Large Language Model Response for Mental Health Support

bias_targets.methodology: Inferring poster race from social media text using dialect models and LLM prompting, conducting counterfactual demographic leaking experiments by modifying posts to explicitly or implicitly state race, and comparing clinical evaluations and automated empathy scores across racial groups.

Inferring poster gender from text using a lexicon-based regression model and LLM prompting, conducting counterfactual experiments with explicit/implicit gender markers, and comparing automated empathy scores between male and female groups.
Inferring poster age from text using a lexicon-based regression model and LLM prompting, and comparing automated empathy scores across age groups (e.g., under 25 vs. 25 and older).
